lead_headline: DBS Café opens inside Denver Book Society as Kwame Spearman's indie bookstore-café debuts in City Park West — 1 opening lead today

restaurant.blurb: 1 new lead today: DBS Café opens in City Park West inside Denver Book Society, former Tattered Cover CEO Kwame Spearman's indie bookstore. Active pipeline 297 (159 openings, 138 closures).

liquor.blurb: 1 new application today: Murphy USA #5533 files for fermented malt license at 7150 Leetsdale Dr in Glendale. Meanwhile, 11 status flips — Lowry Liquors, Trattoria Stella (W 32nd Ave), Belles and Boots, Kona Grill, Colorado Beverage Co., and Onefold all clear delinquency to active. Uncle (W 32nd), Welton Street Cafe, Neveria El Alamo, MDE Lounge, and Painting with a Twist slip delinquent. Week slows to 152 applications vs. 274 prior week as post-freeze pipeline surge moderates.

reputation.blurb: 2 mentions yesterday — Friday doubles Thursday's output but remains historically weak as weekly total limps to 66 mentions across 17 sources, down 11% from prior week's 74. Instagram dominates at 19, Denver Post and Reddit tied at 10, Facebook 10, Hoodline 3. Top pickups: Denver Post covers $8M Castle Pines mansion sale, Reddit discusses Thornton Walmart drone delivery, Instagram features Czech pastry entrepreneur. Daily acquisition rate 1.3 vs. 10.6/day needed to match prior week. Two days left in tracking window — week will close 8-10 mentions below prior period, confirming second consecutive weekly decline.

MTD deteriorates to −20 (−1.2/day), 90-day cumulative +88. Past 7 days worsen to −23 net (10 new, 33 canceled) vs. prior week's −8 — a 15-subscriber collapse that marks July's worst weekly performance yet. The pattern solidifies: July tracks as worst acquisition month on record with churn running more than 3:1 against sign-ups this week. YTD net holds at +206 (+1.0/day) purely on Q1-Q2 carryover.
